treatment: Two SVG image references to the unchanged original spectrum: full overview and X-only magnified clipped detail. Both show source y=0..150.97 at exactly the same displayed height and Y scale. Presentation-only horizontal selection pans with pointer movement/click/touch or keyboard on the overview; there are no sliders or visible interaction instructions. No peaks, labels, integration values or axes are recreated.
initialSelection: Horizontal centre x=248. Selection is clamped inside the original SVG. Arrow keys move by0.25source units; PageUp/PageDown by10; Home/End select the bounds. Y never changes.
